CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 30

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

3. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 81

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 18

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
